request: Write a how-to guide for support staff from these notes. They know the product. They do not read the code. They use the guide to answer a ticket about webhooks that stopped.
input: webhook delivery = WebhookDispatcher in services/webhooks/dispatcher.go, uses the 'wh-out' Kafka topic. Rewritten in v4.1 after the old sync design blocked checkout (see RFC-88). Retries 5 times over 2h with backoff, then marks endpoint as 'failing'. After 3 days failing we auto-disable the endpoint and email the account owner. Customer can re-enable in Settings > Webhooks, and replay missed events from the last 7 days with the Replay button. Events older than 7 days are gone. Signature check failures on their side show as HTTP 401 in the delivery log, error code WH-401.
